summary: The candidate fixes the benchmark-side readiness race described by the issue. On the recorded base, a controlled PD-router double returning 200 from /v1/models while returning 503 from /health_generate caused bench_serving to declare readiness immediately and continue into model setup. At the exact candidate commit, the identical CLI polled /health_generate and stopped only after the configured readiness timeout. The actual PD router implementation makes /health_generate depend on successful generation-health probes to both a selected prefill and decode worker, so this endpoint represents the required end-to-end readiness contract. This is a source fix with regression coverage, not test-only hardening.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reviewed change and reproduced defect are HTTP readiness selection in Python. The assigned gfx950 was not used because GPU numerics do not qualify this control-plane contract.

remaining_limitations: The reported GLM-5.2-FP8 weights and two H200x8 nodes were unavailable; the full CUDA TP8 multi-node Mooncake workload was not reproduced.
The available single gfx950 ROCm 7.2 system cannot qualify H200/CUDA behavior, model semantic accuracy, or multi-node transport behavior.
The deterministic router double validates the reported readiness ordering and the real PD router source validates the endpoint semantics; it is not a full-model serving run.
